subject: Re: [knitr] Using other languages in a .Rnw file

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Using other languages in a .Rnw file
parts:
In Rmd you use ```{r}; in Rnw you just use <<>>=, and there is nothing
else to remember, e.g.

<<engine='sh'>>=
ls *.png
@

Note it is engine instead of lang. Support to sh and bash was added
after v0.7, so you need the latest version on Github:
https://github.com/yihui/knitr#readme

Regards,
Yihui
